tasks.title: SQLCipher store configuration
tasks.acceptance_criterion: DB/WAL/journals are encrypted; temp storage is memory-only; keyless access fails.
tasks.focused_test: Synthetic marker and keyless/correct-key inspection of actual DB/journal/temp paths.

tasks.title: Final message write
tasks.acceptance_criterion: Finalized authorized user/reply text persists transactionally with session/source IDs and expiry.
tasks.focused_test: Restart store; committed turn survives; aborted/private turn creates no row.

tasks.title: Storage quota accounting
tasks.acceptance_criterion: 250MB accounting includes database/indexes/journals/inbox and reserved maintenance; excludes generic models.
tasks.focused_test: Synthetic bounded files show exact account membership and warning at proposed80%.

tasks.title: Interrupted reply write
tasks.acceptance_criterion: Interrupted reply stores truthful interruption/progress status, not assumed complete hearing.
tasks.focused_test: Mid-output fixture commits appropriate final/interrupted fields.

tasks.title: History read pagination
tasks.acceptance_criterion: Authorized bounded pages exclude expired/deleted/private data.
tasks.focused_test: Seed >page-size; validate bounds, ordering and locked denial.

tasks.title: Retention filter
tasks.acceptance_criterion: 90day default and selected retention exclude expired records before any read/retrieval.
tasks.focused_test: Controlled clock including backwards/forwards changes; expired sources never returned.

tasks.title: History write reservation
tasks.acceptance_criterion: No history-enabled turn starts without safe write reservation; full storage never silently switches privacy mode.
tasks.focused_test: Near-cap/disk-full/write-failure fixtures preserve prior history and return actionable error.

tasks.title: Delete source transaction
tasks.acceptance_criterion: Source deletion immediately removes app-visible message and invalidates dependent facts/index/cache.
tasks.focused_test: Linked-source fixture and forced rollback verify atomic cascade and no stale recall.

tasks.title: Retention physical cleanup
tasks.acceptance_criterion: Eligible cleanup removes expired rows/dependencies within bounded maintenance transactions.
tasks.focused_test: Restart/failure mid-cleanup preserves consistency; do not promise exact deletion time while OS stopped.

tasks.title: Delete-all key reset
tasks.acceptance_criterion: Authenticated delete-all cancels work, removes personal stores/inbox/keys and rejects stale reads/writes.
tasks.focused_test: Reset race fixture; old ciphertext inaccessible; new storage requires fresh approved consent.

direct_manifest_inventory: No SQLCipher declaration in the five inspected direct mobile dependency manifests; no global cache claim.
